name: Creation Groans
overview: Scripture reveals that God created the heavens and the earth perfectly in the beginning, but sin entered the world through one man, causing death and widespread corruption (Genesis 1:1; Romans 5:12). As a result, creation itself was cursed and subjected to sorrow and pain, groaning and laboring under the weight of sin's consequences until the redemption of God's children is fully revealed (Genesis 3:17; Romans 8:22, 8:19). This groaning is a sign of the fallen state of the world and the anticipation of Christ's return, when all creation will be restored.
